title: The Armorer
subtitle: Steel Shapes Us
text: Action [Exhaust]: Play an upgrade from your resources on a unit that entered play this phase (paying its cost). If you do, resource the top card of your deck.
deployBox: When Attack Ends: You may play an upgrade from your resources on a friendly unit. If you do, resource the top card of your deck.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 5 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
You can use The Armorer's ability to play any card that can be played as an upgrade, including Pilots.
You may use the upgrade you play using The Armorer's ability to help pay for its cost, since it’s still a resource while paying costs.
Abilities that let you play a card require you to pay that card’s cost unless specified otherwise.
When Attack Ends abilities trigger at the same time as units deal combat damage. The Armorer does not need to survive the attack in order for you to play an upgrade, though you can't play an upgrade on her if she is defeated.
Resources enter play exhausted.
